The error comes from the word "input" in a comment, which the checker rejects. I removed it and kept the double-tail-style StrongARM topology unchanged. I also made the predictions more robust.


```python
PARAMS = {
    "w_tail": (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "w_in":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),
    "w_ln":   (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
    "w_lp":   (3.0, 0.84, 8.0),
    "w_rst":  (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
    "w_invn": (1.5, 0.42, 6.0),
    "w_invp": (3.0, 0.84, 12.0),
    "L":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    L = p["L"]
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # tail switch (clk high = evaluate)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], L)
    # differential pair: vinp discharges dip -> xp falls -> outp high
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "xp", "xn", "dip", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xn", "xp", "din", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    # precharge switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("Mr1", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr2", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mr4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], 0.15)
    # output buffers (precharge: both outputs low)
    n.M("Mo1n", "outp", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mo1p", "outp", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_invp"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mo2n", "outn", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_invn"], 0.15)
    n.M("Mo2p", "outn", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_invp"], 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    oin = lut.op("n", p["w_in"], L, 0.75, 0.6)
    oln = lut.op("n", p["w_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
    olp = lut.op("p", p["w_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
    oinvn = lut.op("n", p["w_invn"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)
    oinvp = lut.op("p", p["w_invp"], 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)
    c_d = (p["w_in"] + p["w_ln"] + p["w_rst"]) * 0.8e-15
    c_x = (2 * p["w_ln"] + 2 * p["w_lp"] + p["w_rst"]) * 0.9e-15 \
          + (p["w_invn"] + p["w_invp"]) * 1.0e-15
    itail = max(abs(oin["Id"]) * 2, 1e-5)
    t_int = (c_d + c_x) * 0.8 / (itail / 2)
    av = max(abs(oin["gm"]) * t_int / max(c_x, 1e-16), 1.0)
    gm_l = abs(oln["gm"]) + abs(olp["gm"])
    tau = c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / max(av * dv, 1e-6), 1.0))
    idrv = max(min(abs(oinvn["Id"]), abs(oinvp["Id"])), 1e-6)
    t_inv = 0.69 * cl * VDD / 2 / idrv
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 2 * c_x * 0.6 + cl + p["w_tail"] * 0.5e-15
    energy = c_sw * VDD ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
